description: This PHP class defines the ServiceCatalogClient for AWS Service Catalog, including method annotations for various API actions such as createPortfolio, deleteProduct, describePortfolio, etc. It extends the AwsClient to facilitate interaction with the AWS Service Catalog service.

classes.name: ServiceCatalogClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Service Catalog, providing methods corresponding to AWS Service Catalog API actions.

methods.name: associateBudgetWithResource
methods.description: Associates a budget with a resource.

methods.name: associatePrincipalWithPortfolio
methods.description: Associates a principal with a specific portfolio.

methods.name: createPortfolio
methods.description: Creates a new portfolio in AWS Service Catalog.

methods.name: describeProduct
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific product.
